note: The Hillsborough County Supervisor of Elections index of past election results lists every City of Tampa municipal election. It lists regular Tampa elections in 2003, 2007, 2011, 2015, 2019 and 2023 only, in March of odd years with runoffs after. The index lists no mayoral contest in this year. The only other Tampa elections listed are a 2016 council runoff and a 2025 special election for City Council District 5, with no mayoral race. The next regular Tampa election falls in 2027, after the cutoff.
